question.text: In the AIF service-provider ecosystem, the CUSTODIAN is primarily responsible for:

answer.text: Maintaining investor unit records and processing subscriptions/redemptions
Filing the PPM with SEBI on behalf of the manager
Auditing the books of the AIF and issuing the financial statements
Safekeeping of securities on behalf of the investors (holding assets of the fund)

explanation.text: The Logic: The custodian safeguards the securities and assets of the AIF on behalf of investors. Investor unit records (subscriptions/redemptions) fall with the Registrar & Transfer Agent (RTA). Auditors handle book audit. Merchant banker files the PPM. The Trap: Options A, B, C describe distinct service providers (RTA, Merchant Banker, Auditor). Conflating custodian with RTA is the classic mistake. Note: The workbook (pp. 100-101, 124) maps the RTA, merchant banker, custodian, and auditor as separate service providers, with the custodian's role limited to safekeeping of fund assets.
